Also, ensure that your computer's sleep settings are not interfering with the monitor's sleep mode. You can check this in the power options on your Windows system. If the issue persists, it might be a hardware issue with the monitor, and you may need to contact Dell support or consider replacing the monitor.

title: Windows 10 update KB4625172 causing issues with touchpad gestures on Dell laptops.
content:

Windows 10 update KB4625172 causing issues with touchpad gestures on Dell laptops.

Update the touchpad driver, disable any custom touchpad settings, and ensure the system BIOS is up-to-date to resolve any known issues with touchpad functionality.

title: Windows blue screen (BSOD) occurs on all systems.
content:
Problem:
Windows blue screen (BSOD) occurs on all systems.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:

title: Windows update installation fails with error code 0x80070005.
content:
Problem:
Windows update installation fails with error code 0x80070005.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run Windows Update Troubleshooter, check disk space, disable security software, use `wsusutil reset` if internal WSUS, and ensure network connectivity to Microsoft servers.

title: Windows activation error 0x8007234C persists after reinstall.
content:
Problem:
Windows activation error 0x8007234C persists after reinstall.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clear activation cache with `slmgr.vbs /ckexpgreg`, reset activation with `slmgr.vbs /rearm`, check for volume license key issues, and verify system BIOS/UEFI integrity.

title: Windows 10/11 update loop with 20H2 repeatedly failing.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10/11 update loop with 20H2 repeatedly failing.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable selective startup, run `sfc /scannow`, clean component store with `dism`, check CBS corruption via `fsutil harderror dumplog`, and force update via Windows Update or Media Creation Tool.

title: Windows cannot be activated due to digital license corruption.
content:
Problem:
Windows cannot be activated due to digital license corruption.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reset digital license via `slmgr.vbs /ato`, check TPM status and clear BCD with `bcdedit /deletevalue {current} safeboot`, and ensure firmware is up-to-date.

title: Windows Defender mistakenly quarantined critical system files.
content:
Problem:
Windows Defender mistakenly quarantined critical system files.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Restore quarantined files via Windows Defender UI, run `sfc /scannow`, scan again with elevated DAT, and exclude specific files/folders from future scans.

title: Windows event log filled with system errors from unknown sources.
content:
Problem:
Windows event log filled with system errors from unknown sources.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Stop erroneous services via Services.msc, use Event Viewer to filter by source, check for malware, and run `chkdsk /f` to verify disk integrity.

title: Windows Explorer search indexing corrupts files during scan.
content:
Problem:
Windows Explorer search indexing corrupts files during scan.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild search index via Indexing Options, disable real-time protection temporarily, check for conflicting services, and repair master file table (MFT) with `fsutil harderror dumplog if needed.

title: Windows fails to boot with STOP code 0x00000050 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE).
content:
Problem:
Windows fails to boot with STOP code 0x00000050 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable Secure Boot, run startup repair from Advanced Startup Options, perform memory diagnostic, and check for incompatible driver installations.

content:

Windows Hello PIN authentication fails repeatedly on login.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reset PIN via Credential Manager, re-enroll PIN using Windows Hello, check TPM owner password if present, and ensure Bitlocker is not interfering.

content:

Windows Insider Program preview builds cause system instability.

content:

Windows password reset disk fails to boot from USB.

Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing fails with audio dropouts.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update Teams client, check local microphone and audio drivers, test audio output/input devices, and verify firewall ports for audio streaming.

title: Outlook 2019 stuck at 'Connecting to Microsoft Exchange' indefinitely.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 stuck at 'Connecting to Microsoft Exchange' indefinitely.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Repair the Outlook profile, disable conflicting add-ins, check network connectivity to Exchange server, and verify Autodiscover configuration.

title: Dell laptop experiencing random BSOD with stop code KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR.
content:
Problem:
Dell laptop experiencing random BSOD with stop code KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run Dell DataSanity diagnostics, replace faulty RAM modules, check hard drive health via SMART data, and rebuild the BCD store.

title: User reports inability to receive emails from external domains in Outlook.
content:
Problem:
User reports inability to receive emails from external domains in Outlook.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Outlook junk email settings, verify MX records for external domain, test email connectivity with telnet, and ensure SMTP/IMAP/POP3 ports are open.

title: M365 licensing shows unused seats but users report service interruptions.
content:
Problem:
M365 licensing shows unused seats but users report service interruptions.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review Azure AD Connect synchronization status, check for expired licenses, verify service health in M365 admin center, and audit license usage reports.

title: Lenovo T490 webcam not working in native Windows camera app.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 webcam not working in native Windows camera app.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reinstall integrated Dell Webcam Central drivers, update camera firmware if available, check device manager for camera status, and verify camera permissions.

title: VPN connection establishes but internal network resources are unreachable.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection establishes but internal network resources are unreachable.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check split tunneling configuration, verify DNS resolution from the VPN client, test local and remote network connectivity, and ensure firewall rules allow internal traffic.

title: Windows 11 update 22H2 installation fails with error 0x8000FFFF.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update 22H2 installation fails with error 0x8000FFFF.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image, run the built-in Windows Update troubleshooter, disable third-party antivirus, and check CBS health via sfc /scannow.

title: Teams call quality metrics show high packet loss during meetings.
content:
Problem:
Teams call quality metrics show high packet loss during meetings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check local network jitter and latency, disable network virtualization, update audio drivers, and test connection speed to the Teams meeting server.

title: HP Elitebook experiencing frequent kernel mode trap errors (KEB).
content:
Problem:
HP Elitebook experiencing frequent kernel mode trap errors (KEB).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Analyze system event logs for KEB errors, run hardware diagnostics for memory and hard drive, update BIOS/UEFI, and check for overheating.

title: Outlook add-in causes M365 sign-out issues and prevents calendar sync.
content:
Problem:
Outlook add-in causes M365 sign-out issues and prevents calendar sync.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable the problematic add-in via Trust Center, re-enable it after troubleshooting, update the add-in, and check for conflicts with other add-ins.

title: Users report intermittent slow performance on Windows 7 machines.
content:
Problem:
Users report intermittent slow performance on Windows 7 machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Perform malware scans, check for rogue startup items, verify disk fragmentation, and monitor resource utilization (CPU, Memory, Disk).

title: M3leshoot Teams deployment failed with code 0x80070522 on Windows 10.
content:
Problem:
M3leshoot Teams deployment failed with code 0x80070522 on Windows 10.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-run the Teams deployment troubleshooter, check for prerequisite components, ensure Microsoft Edge is updated, and verify network access to deployment servers.

title: VPN client fails to connect with error 'The request was aborted: Could not establish the connection' on Windows 11.
content:
Problem:
VPN client fails to connect with error 'The request was aborted: Could not establish the connection' on Windows 11.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for recent Windows updates causing conflicts, reset the Winsock catalog, disable IPv6, and verify the VPN server's FQDN resolves correctly.

title: Domain-joined computers cannot connect to internal Active Directory services.
content:
Problem:
Domain-joined computers cannot connect to internal Active Directory services.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check domain controller status and replication, verify DNS resolution for AD DCs, test connectivity to AD ports, and ensure account has necessary permissions.

title: Teams meeting invites show 'Cannot start meeting' error for all users.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting invites show 'Cannot start meeting' error for all users.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Teams service status in M365, verify meeting policy settings, test meeting creation on the user's device, and check for tenant-level issues.

title: Lenovo docking station ports intermittently lose connectivity for peripherals.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo docking station ports intermittently lose connectivity for peripherals.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-seat internal cables, update docking station firmware, test with different USB ports, and check for power delivery issues.

title: Windows 10 activation center shows 'Windows is not genuine' despite correct key.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 activation center shows 'Windows is not genuine' despite correct key.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use slmgr.vbs /ato to activate manually, re-enter the volume key via System > About > Windows activation, and check for Group Policy override.

title: Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Verifying trust...' when connecting to Exchange Online.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Verifying trust...' when connecting to Exchange Online.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable Enhanced Security Warning, check for recent Exchange updates, verify certificate trust chain, and ensure TLS is configured correctly.

title: User unable to join Windows 10 Pro device to Azure AD.
content:
Problem:
User unable to join Windows 10 Pro device to Azure AD.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify Azure AD join prerequisites, check device hybrid configuration, ensure correct user permissions, and test Azure AD Connect synchronization.

title: Dell monitor displays incorrect resolution and refresh rate options in Windows display settings.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays incorrect resolution and refresh rate options in Windows display settings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update video card drivers, use Dell Display Manager if available, manually set resolution via command line (mode), and check for firmware updates on the monitor.

title: M365 Conditional Access policy blocks VPN users from accessing Teams.
content:
Problem:
M365 Conditional Access policy blocks VPN users from accessing Teams.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review and modify Conditional Access policy to allow when running from VPN, check device compliance requirements, and ensure user device meets criteria.

title: Windows 11 update KB5000828 installation fails with error 0x80070642.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update KB5000828 installation fails with error 0x80070642.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Download and install the update manually from Microsoft Update Catalog, clear the pending device driver installation via Deployment Image Servicing and Management (DISM), and run the update troubleshooter.

title: Teams screen sharing works but participants cannot see the shared screen.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing works but participants cannot see the shared screen.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Teams meeting permissions for screen sharing, ensure the presenter has screen sharing capability, test sharing on different devices, and check for browser compatibility.

title: HP laptop battery calibration fails and reported capacity is inaccurate.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop battery calibration fails and reported capacity is inaccurate.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use HP Battery Calibration tool, ensure the battery is fully drained before calibration, update HP Support Assistant, and check for BIOS battery calibration settings.

title: VPN client prompts for credentials every time despite smart card configuration.
content:
Problem:
VPN client prompts for credentials every time despite smart card configuration.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reconfigure VPN profile with smart card certificate, ensure CRL checks are correctly configured, and validate certificate trust on the client.

title: Windows 7 machines experiencing blue screen (0x100000006) after installing a specific driver.
content:
Problem:
Windows 7 machines experiencing blue screen (0x100000006) after installing a specific driver.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Roll back the recently installed driver, use System File Checker (sfc /scannow), and check for hardware compatibility list (HCL) issues.

title: Outlook 2019 stuck on 'Saving changes' during compose email.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 stuck on 'Saving changes' during compose email.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable add-ins, reset Outlook to default settings, check OST file size, and increase mailbox storage limit if necessary.

title: M365 user account locked out due to too many invalid password attempts.
content:
Problem:
M365 user account locked out due to too many invalid password attempts.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Initiate user account unlock request from Azure AD admin center, check Azure AD Identity Protection policies, and verify multi-factor authentication (MFA) settings.

title: Teams call audio works but video is pixelated and choppy.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio works but video is pixelated and choppy.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network bandwidth usage, disable bandwidth savings in Teams settings, test with different codecs, and check for network congestion.

title: Windows 10 device cannot connect to the company wireless network.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 device cannot connect to the company wireless network.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Forget the network, ensure Windows Firewall allows network discovery, check for rogue Wi-Fi profiles, and verify the SSID is broadcasted correctly.

title: Lenovo laptop fan noise increases randomly with no change in temperature.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop fan noise increases randomly with no change in temperature.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean internal dust, update thermal sensors firmware, check for thermal paste degradation, and run hardware monitor tools to track temperatures.

title: VPN tunnel establishes but internal applications report connection refused errors.
content:
Problem:
VPN tunnel establishes but internal applications report connection refused errors.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check firewall rules on the VPN server to allow internal traffic, verify split tunneling is configured correctly, and test internal server reachability from the VPN client.

title: Windows Update downloads updates but fails to install with error 0x80070643.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update downloads updates but fails to install with error 0x80070643.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the built-in Windows Update troubleshooter, disable Windows Defender real-time protection temporarily, check for disk space, and repair the update using dism.

title: Outlook 2016 calendar invites show 'Cannot accept or decline' error.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 calendar invites show 'Cannot accept or decline' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check meeting organizer's email settings, verify calendar permissions on the resource, disable conflicting add-ins, and check for Exchange connectivity issues.

title: M365 Exchange Online mailbox shows 50GB warning but user reports no storage used.
content:
Problem:
M365 Exchange Online mailbox shows 50GB warning but user reports no storage used.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for large archive files, use the Exchange admin center to view mailbox statistics, check for hidden items in Outlook, and verify storage limit configuration.

title: Teams meeting recordings fail to download with error code 0x80070520.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting recordings fail to download with error code 0x80070520.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check proxy server settings, disable VPN temporarily, ensure Teams client is updated, and verify meeting recording permissions in the tenant.

title: Dell XPS 13 experiencing touchpad cursor jumping during use.
content:
Problem:
Dell XPS 13 experiencing touchpad cursor jumping during use.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-calibrate touchpad, disable touchpad in BIOS, update touchpad drivers, and check for interference with wireless devices.

title: User reports slow boot time on Windows 11 after installing a new driver.
content:
Problem:
User reports slow boot time on Windows 11 after installing a new driver.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Roll back the driver, check startup items and services, run Storage Optimization, and perform a clean boot to isolate software issues.

title: VPN client disconnects automatically after 30 minutes, despite idle timeout settings.
content:
Problem:
VPN client disconnects automatically after 30 minutes, despite idle timeout settings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for system sleep/power settings, disable aggressive firewall timeouts, and configure the VPN client to keep the connection alive.

title: Outlook 2019 stuck on 'Waiting for server response' when sending/receiving mail.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 stuck on 'Waiting for server response' when sending/receiving mail.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network latency to the Exchange server, disable any VPN connections, run ipconfig /release and renew, and verify MX record health.

title: M365 Azure Active Directory Connect sync fails with error 0x80072EE2.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure Active Directory Connect sync fails with error 0x80072EE2.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check event logs on AAD Connect servers, verify network connectivity between on-premises and Azure AD, and ensure outbound HTTPS 443 ports are open.

title: Teams call audio works but video shows 'Camera not working' error.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio works but video shows 'Camera not working' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Teams camera settings, reinstall camera drivers, test with other applications like Windows Camera, and verify camera permissions.

title: Windows 10 device shows 'Network location changed' notification frequently.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 device shows 'Network location changed' notification frequently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for IP conflicts, verify DHCP/DNS settings, disable IPv6, and ensure network adapter drivers are up-to-date.

title: Lenovo T590 docking station loses connection to peripherals after waking from sleep.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T590 docking station loses connection to peripherals after waking from sleep.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update docking station firmware, re-seat USB cables, use Lenovo Vantage to configure docking station, and check power management settings.

title: User reports inability to print to network printer from Windows 10.
content:
Problem:
User reports inability to print to network printer from Windows 10.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check printer connection and status, remove and re-add the printer, check print server configuration, and ensure printer driver compatibility.

title: Windows 11 activation requires phone contact despite having a volume license key.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 activation requires phone contact despite having a volume license key.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Ensure the device is properly domain-joined, use Volume Activation Tools (slmgr.vbs), and check for activation policies configured in M365.

title: Outlook 2016 autodiscover fails, preventing profile creation.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 autodiscover fails, preventing profile creation.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use the Microsoft Remote Connectivity Analyzer, check ADFS configuration, ensure port 443 is open, and manually configure Outlook profile settings.

title: M365 Teams chat messages send but fail to appear in the chat history.
content:
Problem:
M365 Teams chat messages send but fail to appear in the chat history.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clear Teams cache, re-add the account to Teams, check for large message attachments, and verify Teams service health in M365.

title: VPN client shows 'Tunnel is down' but no error message provided.
content:
Problem:
VPN client shows 'Tunnel is down' but no error message provided.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check VPN server logs for connection drops, verify client certificate validity, test ping to the VPN server, and ensure tunnel keep-alive settings.

title: Windows 7 machines experience blue screen (0x000000C4) during gaming sessions.
content:
Problem:
Windows 7 machines experience blue screen (0x000000C4) during gaming sessions.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update graphics drivers, disable non-critical startup items, check for overheating, and ensure system is below recommended specifications.

title: Outlook 2019 search index corruption prevents finding emails.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 search index corruption prevents finding emails.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild the Outlook search index, disable full-text search in Windows, use SCANSTAT to identify corrupt files, and compact PST files.

title: M365 user account shows 'License not assigned' in Azure AD despite active subscription.
content:
Problem:
M365 user account shows 'License not assigned' in Azure AD despite active subscription.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify user provisioning is enabled, check for errors during Azure AD Connect sync, and manually assign the license via Azure portal.

title: Teams screen sharing works for some users but not for others in the same meeting.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing works for some users but not for others in the same meeting.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check user device network configurations, ensure browser compatibility for Teams Meetings, and verify meeting organizer's sharing permissions.

title: Dell monitor displays distorted images and colors are off.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays distorted images and colors are off.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use monitor calibration tool, update monitor firmware, adjust color settings in Windows display, and check for physical damage to the screen.

title: Windows 10 device shows 'This device can't run Windows in Safe Mode' despite needing to access it.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 device shows 'This device can't run Windows in Safe Mode' despite needing to access it.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Shift+F10 during boot to access command prompt, boot using Windows installation media, and run bootrec /fixmbr.

title: VPN connection establishes but users report inability to access internal websites.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection establishes but users report inability to access internal websites.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check DNS resolution from the VPN client, verify split tunneling configuration, and ensure internal web servers are accessible from the VPN network.

title: Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Loading Toolbar' for extended periods.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Loading Toolbar' for extended periods.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable all toolbars, reset Outlook add-in permissions, update add-ins, and check for conflicts with third-party security software.

title: M365 Azure AD Connect password hash synchronization fails with event ID 2046.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure AD Connect password hash synchronization fails with event ID 2046.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check event logs for specific errors, verify outbound connectivity to Azure, and ensure user accounts are not locked out during sync.

title: Teams meeting video quality drops frequently during presentations.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting video quality drops frequently during presentations.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Monitor network bandwidth usage, disable background applications, use a wired network connection, and check for network jitter.

title: Lenovo laptop keyboard keys randomly stop responding intermittently.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop keyboard keys randomly stop responding intermittently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update keyboard drivers, check for firmware updates, run hardware diagnostics, and consider replacing the keyboard assembly if confirmed faulty.

title: Windows 11 update KB5005575 installation fails with error 0x8007052D.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update KB5005575 installation fails with error 0x8007052D.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use DISM to repair the image, run the Windows Update troubleshooter, and check for system compatibility with the update before proceeding.

title: Outlook 2019 shows 'Cannot connect to Microsoft Exchange' error when sending mail.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 shows 'Cannot connect to Microsoft Exchange' error when sending mail.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network connectivity to the Exchange server, verify SMTP/DNS settings, and ensure the user has send-as permissions if required.

title: M365 Exchange Online mailbox shows high item counts but user reports no emails received.
content:
Problem:
M365 Exchange Online mailbox shows high item counts but user reports no emails received.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for archived emails, use the Exchange admin center to view item statistics, and investigate email flow with Message Trace.

title: Teams call audio is choppy and dropouts occur during calls.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio is choppy and dropouts occur during calls.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network latency, disable any network-intensive applications, use a wired Ethernet connection if possible, and check for network congestion.

title: Windows 7 machines experience slow performance when running virtual machines.
content:
Problem:
Windows 7 machines experience slow performance when running virtual machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Increase RAM allocation, disable unnecessary services, update virtualization firmware (Intel VT-x/AMD-V), and ensure Hyper-V is not conflicting.

title: Dell docking station ports (USB, HDMI) intermittently lose connection with peripherals.
content:
Problem:
Dell docking station ports (USB, HDMI) intermittently lose connection with peripherals.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update docking station firmware, reseat internal cables, use a different USB port on the docking station, and check for power delivery issues.

title: VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' despite valid certificate and credentials.
content:
Problem:
VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' despite valid certificate and credentials.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reinstall the VPN client, check the certificate trust chain, and verify the VPN server configuration for accepted user credentials.

title: Windows 10 device shows 'Sharing violation' errors when accessing network files.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 device shows 'Sharing violation' errors when accessing network files.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check file permissions, ensure the user has modify rights, disable any antivirus real-time scanning, and check for open file handles.

title: Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Verifying signatures' for a long time on startup.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Verifying signatures' for a long time on startup.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable digital signature verification, update certificate trust, and check for large signature files in the profile.

title: M365 user reports receiving emails in the Junk Email folder but not in the primary inbox.
content:
Problem:
M365 user reports receiving emails in the Junk Email folder but not in the primary inbox.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Junk Email filtering settings, train the Junk Email filter, and manually move items to the inbox to update index.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing works but the presenter cannot share applications.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing works but the presenter cannot share applications.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Teams application permissions for sharing, ensure no other sharing applications are running, and update Teams client to the latest version.

title: Windows 11 activation fails with error 0xC004F074 on a clean installation.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 activation fails with error 0xC004F074 on a clean installation.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use the Volume Activation Microsoft Utility (VAMTU), ensure the correct product key is entered, and check for digital license eligibility.

title: Outlook 2019 shows 'Cannot open this document' error when opening .pst files.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 shows 'Cannot open this document' error when opening .pst files.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use SCANPST.EXE to repair the file, convert the .pst file to a newer format, and check for file corruption using third-party tools.

title: M365 Azure Active Directory Connect sync fails with error 0x8007052D.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure Active Directory Connect sync fails with error 0x8007052D.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify outbound HTTPS connectivity to Azure, check for firewall blocks, and ensure the AAD Connect version is compatible with the Azure AD schema.

title: Teams call video works but audio has echo and feedback issues.
content:
Problem:
Teams call video works but audio has echo and feedback issues.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable speakerphone if used, move participants to a quieter environment, check audio device settings, and use headphones.

title: Windows 7 machines experience frequent BSOD (Stop error) with code 0x0000001A.
content:
Problem:
Windows 7 machines experience frequent BSOD (Stop error) with code 0x0000001A.

Check for failing hard drive, run chkdsk, scan for viruses, and update disk drivers to resolve hardware-related issues.

title: Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Checking for server updates' during startup.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Checking for server updates' during startup.

Disable automatic server updates, configure Outlook to update manually, and check for conflicts with system updates.

title: M365 user account shows 'User account disabled' in Azure AD despite active subscription.
content:
Problem:
M365 user account shows 'User account disabled' in Azure AD despite active subscription.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for Azure AD Connect sync errors, verify user account status in Azure portal, and ensure no conditional access policies disable the account.

title: Teams meeting audio works but participants report hearing crackling and distortion.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting audio works but participants report hearing crackling and distortion.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check audio hardware for issues, update sound card drivers, disable audio enhancements in sound settings, and test with different audio devices.

title: Windows 10 device shows 'Network path not found' error when accessing network shares.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 device shows 'Network path not found' error when accessing network shares.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network connectivity, verify share permissions, disable any VPN or proxy connections, and check DNS resolution for the server.

title: Dell monitor displays incorrect colors and calibration issues persist.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays incorrect colors and calibration issues persist.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use monitor calibration software, update monitor drivers, and adjust color profiles in Windows display settings.

title: VPN client shows 'Tunnel Establishment Timeout' error when connecting.
content:
Problem:
VPN client shows 'Tunnel Establishment Timeout' error when connecting.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network latency to the VPN server, ensure no firewall blocks the connection, and verify the VPN server is reachable from the client network.

title: Outlook 2019 shows 'Cannot send or receive from Microsoft Exchange' error.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 shows 'Cannot send or receive from Microsoft Exchange' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Exchange connectivity using Test Connectivity in the Exchange admin center, verify user permissions, and ensure the Outlook profile is configured correctly.

title: M365 Azure AD Connect password sync fails with event ID 2048.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure AD Connect password sync fails with event ID 2048.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check event logs for specific errors, verify user account status in Azure AD, and ensure no password filtering agents are blocking the sync.

title: Teams call audio works but the speaker's video is frozen.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio works but the speaker's video is frozen.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the participant's network connection, disable any bandwidth-intensive applications, and ensure the Teams client is updated.

title: Windows 11 update installation gets stuck at 'Preparing to install the update' phase.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update installation gets stuck at 'Preparing to install the update' phase.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use System Restore to a previous state, run the Windows Update troubleshooter, and check for pending driver updates that might conflict.

title: Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Opening Outlook Data File' when starting.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Opening Outlook Data File' when starting.

Repair the Outlook profile using the instructions in Control Panel, compact the PST file, and ensure there is sufficient disk space.

content:

M365 user reports receiving emails but not sending emails from their mailbox.

Check email sending settings in Outlook, verify user has send permissions, and use Message Trace in Exchange Online to investigate.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing works but the cursor movements are not captured.

Teams meeting screen sharing works but the cursor movements are not captured.

Ensure the 'Share my mouse cursor' option is enabled in Teams settings, update Teams client, and check for system resource limitations.

title: Windows 7 machines experience slow boot time due to excessive services starting.

Problem:
Windows 7 machines experience slow boot time due to excessive services starting.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable non-essential startup items, configure Windows Firewall to allow necessary services, and use msconfig to disable suspicious services.

title: Dell docking station overheats and automatically shuts down peripherals.
content:
Problem:
Dell docking station overheats and automatically shuts down peripherals.

Improve cooling by cleaning dust, ensure proper ventilation, use a cooling pad, and check for overloading the docking station with too many devices.

Check the certificate chain for missing intermediate certificates, ensure the system date and time are correct, and verify the certificate is trusted by the client.

Disable Windows Update background caching, run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image, reset Windows Update components, and re-run Windows Update.

title: M365 login fails with error 403 Forbidden
content:

M365 login fails with error 403 Forbidden

Check tenant health status, verify user license assignment, inspect conditional access policies, and reset M365 service.

title: Teams audio echo during calls

Teams audio echo during calls

Network IP conflict detected on workstation

title: Dell Optiplex boot stuck on black screen
content:
Problem:

Clean the media sensor with the provided cleaning kit, replace the pickup roller, check paper type and alignment, and recalibrate the printer.

title: Dell Optiplex beeps continuously on startup (beep code 1 short).
content:
Problem:
Dell Optiplex beeps continuously on startup (beep code 1 short).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Replace the system board, as a beep code often indicates a critical hardware failure like a missing board.

title: Lenovo T490 webcam disabled in BIOS after OS boot.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 webcam disabled in BIOS after OS boot.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for Lenovo Vantage driver updates, disable Secure Boot, ensure UEFI settings are factory defaults, and reconfigure in BIOS.

title: Network discovery is off but SMB shares are accessible.
content:
Problem:
Network discovery is off but SMB shares are accessible.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enable network discovery via Control Panel, ensure file sharing is turned on, check Windows Firewall inbound rules for file and printer sharing, and verify workgroup/domain membership.

title: Users report slow M365 Teams client.
content:
Problem:
Users report slow M365 Teams client.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Increase M365 client cache quota, check for high CPU/memory usage in Task Manager, disable unused add-ins, and update the Teams client to the latest version.

title: Outlook cannot send/receive emails from Exchange.
content:
Problem:
Outlook cannot send/receive emails from Exchange.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Exchange connectivity with Test Connectivity in the M365 admin center, verify Outlook client profile settings, check firewall rules for SMTP/IMAP/POP ports, and run Outlook repair.

title: VPN client shows 'Internal Certificate Error' during connection.
content:
Problem:
VPN client shows 'Internal Certificate Error' during connection.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reinstall the VPN client, replace the internal certificate (if self-signed), check certificate trust store in Windows, and ensure the VPN server certificate is valid and not expired.

title: Windows Update stuck on downloading for days.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update stuck on downloading for days.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Windows Update troubleshooter, disable Windows Update service and BITS, clear the SoftwareDistribution folder, and use the DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image command.

title: M3leshoot MFA authentication fails for all users.
content:
Problem:
M3leshoot MFA authentication fails for all users.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Azure AD Connect synchronization status, verify user assigned MFA type (e.g., phone, security key), test MFA registration for a test user, and check Conditional Access policies.

title: Team chat messages disappear after 10 minutes.
content:
Problem:
Team chat messages disappear after 10 minutes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check retention policies in M365 Groups, ensure users have the correct license, clear Teams cache, and check for retention settings on the chat channel itself.

title: HP laptop screen flickers and displays 'Display Out Of Range' error.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop screen flickers and displays 'Display Out Of Range' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update video drivers, change display resolution and refresh rate in Display settings, recalibrate the screen, and check for hardware issues (TDR configuration).

title: Lenovo docking station not recognized after wake from sleep.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo docking station not recognized after wake from sleep.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the docking station firmware and drivers, disable selective suspend settings for USB controllers, and check for power management settings.

title: Windows 11 activation fails with error 0xC004F010.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 activation fails with error 0xC004F010.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Activation troubleshooter, ensure Windows 11 Enterprise license is assigned, check KMS server configuration, and verify digital entropy is sufficient.

title: Outlook data file (PST/OST) corrupt causing error 0x800CCC0F.
content:
Problem:
Outlook data file (PST/OST) corrupt causing error 0x800CCC0F.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use SCANPST.exe for PST files or OST.exe for OST files, repair the file using the Inbox Repair Tool, split the file into smaller parts, and restore from backup if necessary.

title: M365 compliance search returns no results for specific users.
content:
Problem:
M365 compliance search returns no results for specific users.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify user mailbox is not litigation hold or retention hold, check search query syntax, ensure the user has eDiscovery mailbox permissions, and verify compliance search connector configuration.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing fails with 'Cannot share screen' error.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing fails with 'Cannot share screen' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Ensure user has permission to share screen, check for accessibility features like Sticky Keys blocking sharing, update graphics drivers, and try sharing the entire screen instead of an application.

title: Dell monitor shows 'Input Signal Lost' after waking from sleep.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor shows 'Input Signal Lost' after waking from sleep.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the video cable connection, update the graphics driver, adjust the monitor's input source manually, and ensure the laptop docking station firmware is updated.

title: Windows 10 update KB5000825 fails with error 0x80070005.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 update KB5000825 fails with error 0x80070005.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Windows Update troubleshooter, disable the problematic update, check CBS corruption with sfc /scannow, and run DISM /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth.

title: VPN client connection drops with 'SSL/TLS Secure Renegotiation Failure' error.
content:
Problem:
VPN client connection drops with 'SSL/TLS Secure Renegotiation Failure' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the VPN client software, check the server's SSL/TLS configuration, disable renegotiation on the server if possible, and ensure the client uses supported cipher suites.

title: Lenovo laptop fan runs constantly at max speed even when idle.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop fan runs constantly at max speed even when idle.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Task Manager for processes using high CPU/RAM, run a full system diagnostic, clean internal dust, and update the system thermal drivers.

title: HP printer shows 'Paused' status with error 38 (door lock) even when unlocked.
content:
Problem:
HP printer shows 'Paused' status with error 38 (door lock) even when unlocked.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reset the printer error code, check for physical door lock mechanism, update the printer firmware, and clear the print spooler and configuration files.

title: Windows 11 event logs filled with 'VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE' errors.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 event logs filled with 'VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE' errors.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update GPU drivers, adjust TDR settings via the registry (increase LatencyToleranceTimeout), disable GPU acceleration in display settings, and check for overheating.

title: Outlook 2019 keeps prompting for credential re-entry during send/receive.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 keeps prompting for credential re-entry during send/receive.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild the Outlook data file cache (ost file), disable roaming profiles or check Roaming Profiles configuration, clear the Windows Vault credential store, and check SmartScreen for false positives.

title: Team channel permissions changed automatically after Azure AD sync.
content:
Problem:
Team channel permissions changed automatically after Azure AD sync.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Azure AD Connect attribute filtering, review Azure AD conditional access policies, manually reassign channel memberships, and ensure the Azure AD Connect tool is running smoothly.

title: Users cannot join Teams meetings scheduled before July 2020.
content:
Problem:
Users cannot join Teams meetings scheduled before July 2020.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enable retroactive scheduling in the Teams admin center, ensure users have the correct permissions to join meetings, and check Azure AD license expiration dates.

title: Windows 10 Task Manager shows high GPU usage by explorer.exe.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 Task Manager shows high GPU usage by explorer.exe.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run a system file check (sfc /scannow), disable Aero Glass effects, check for malware infections, and perform a clean boot to isolate startup items.

title: M365 SharePoint site appears blank in the browser.
content:
Problem:
M365 SharePoint site appears blank in the browser.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check browser console for errors, clear browser cache, try different browsers, check the site's web analytics to confirm traffic, and verify the site template is active.

title: Dell desktop mouse cursor disappears intermittently.
content:
Problem:
Dell desktop mouse cursor disappears intermittently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for driver conflicts, test with a different mouse, check USB ports for power issues, run hardware diagnostics, and update the motherboard chipset drivers.

title: Lenovo laptop touchpad gestures not working after wake from hibernate.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop touchpad gestures not working after wake from hibernate.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the touchpad driver, disable and re-enable the touchpad in Device Manager, check for power settings disabling touchpad, and run the hardware diagnostics tool.

title: VPN client connects but cannot access internal corporate resources.
content:
Problem:
VPN client connects but cannot access internal corporate resources.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the VPN client's split tunnel configuration, verify firewall rules allow traffic to internal resources, use tracert to test connectivity post-VPN, and check DNS settings within the VPN tunnel.

title: Windows 11 activation region changed error.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 activation region changed error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use the Activate your copy of Windows tool, re-enter the product key, ensure the digital license is transferred correctly, and check for conflicting OEM license keys.

title: Outlook 2021 calendar invites disappear from inbox.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2021 calendar invites disappear from inbox.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Configure Outlook to treat calendar invites as meeting requests, check junk mail settings, disable rules affecting calendar items, and repair the Outlook profile.

title: Teams screen sharing works but audio is choppy.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing works but audio is choppy.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network bandwidth using speedtest.net, prioritize Teams traffic in QoS settings, disable background processes using high bandwidth, and update audio drivers.

title: HP laserjet printer shows 'Memory Error' during print job.
content:
Problem:
HP laserjet printer shows 'Memory Error' during print job.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Print a configuration page to check for firmware errors, replace the toner cartridge (low memory sometimes triggered by toner level), and check for paper jams in the fuser assembly.

title: Windows 10 disk defragmentation stuck at 100% but no progress.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 disk defragmentation stuck at 100% but no progress.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Cancel the operation, check for pending disk write operations, run chkdsk /f, and ensure the drive is not in use or has write protection enabled.

title: M365 Exchange Online Protection (EOP) quarantined suspicious email not delivered.
content:
Problem:
M365 Exchange Online Protection (EOP) quarantined suspicious email not delivered.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review the quarantined messages in Security & Compliance Center, configure mail flow rules to allow senders, and check sender reputation and DKIM/DSPF records.

title: Lenovo docking station USB ports intermittently lose power.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo docking station USB ports intermittently lose power.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Test the docking station with different USB ports on the laptop, update the docking station firmware, and check for firmware updates for the laptop's USB controllers.

title: Users report 'Your organization's domain name changed' error in Teams.
content:
Problem:
Users report 'Your organization's domain name changed' error in Teams.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the domain name in Azure AD, propagate DNS changes for the domain, update MX records in DNS, and clear the Teams client cache.

title: Dell monitor displays a black screen with 'No Input' after connecting via HDMI.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays a black screen with 'No Input' after connecting via HDMI.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the HDMI cable and try different ports, update the graphics driver, check display settings in Windows, and try connecting to another computer to isolate the issue.

title: Windows 11 update KB5005591 causes blue screen of death (BSOD).
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update KB5005591 causes blue screen of death (BSOD).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Roll back the update KB5005591, check the Memory Diagnostic results, update all drivers, and run chkdsk to check disk integrity.

title: Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Connecting to Mail Server' loop.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Connecting to Mail Server' loop.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable the 'Use HTTP for Office 365 connections' setting, run the Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant for Outlook, reset the OST file, and check antivirus firewall interference.

title: M365 Azure Active Directory Connect Synchronization Service fails with event ID 4121.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure Active Directory Connect Synchronization Service fails with event ID 4121.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the AD Connect configuration, resolve any Active Directory replication issues, ensure outbound firewall ports are open, and review the event logs for more details.

title: Teams meeting recordings not showing up in the meeting chat history.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting recordings not showing up in the meeting chat history.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the meeting recording settings during the meeting, ensure the user has the correct permissions, and verify the retention policies for meeting data.

title: HP All-in-One printer shows 'Ink System Error' despite ink levels being okay.
content:
Problem:
HP All-in-One printer shows 'Ink System Error' despite ink levels being okay.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean the printhead with the printer's maintenance utility, replace the ink cartridges with new ones, and run the printer's self-test diagnostic.

title: Windows 10 system restore not available or shows 'No restore points found'.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 system restore not available or shows 'No restore points found'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Create a system restore point manually, check the maximum restore point size in System Protection, run sfc /scannow, and check for disk space and date/time synchronization.

title: VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' but certificate presented successfully.
content:
Problem:
VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' but certificate presented successfully.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the VPN server configuration for allowed user groups, ensure the user's certificate has not expired, and verify the client certificate mapping in Azure AD or local AD.

title: Lenovo laptop keyboard keys randomly stop working intermittently.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop keyboard keys randomly stop working intermittently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the hardware diagnostics tool, update the system board drivers, check for liquid damage, and consider a hardware replacement if diagnostics fail.

title: Dell monitor contrast control unresponsive after software update.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor contrast control unresponsive after software update.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the monitor's firmware, check for conflicting software, use the monitor's physical buttons to adjust settings, and try connecting to another computer.

title: Windows 11 Action Center widgets disappear after Windows Update.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 Action Center widgets disappear after Windows Update.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reset the widgets via the Start Menu settings, run the Windows Update Troubleshooter, and check for registry corruption in the Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppModel data.

title: Outlook 2023 ribbon interface corrupted with strange symbols.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2023 ribbon interface corrupted with strange symbols.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Office Repair for Outlook, clear the Office application data files, and reinstall Microsoft 365 Apps for business.

title: M365 Teams persistent chat messages not being delivered to users.
content:
Problem:
M365 Teams persistent chat messages not being delivered to users.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the chat message history in the admin center, verify user status and availability, and ensure the Teams service health is normal.

title: HP laptop fan error light blinking during boot (beep code 2 short).
content:
Problem:
HP laptop fan error light blinking during boot (beep code 2 short).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Replace the thermal paste on the CPU and GPU, clean thermal grease residue, reseat the CPU and GPU heatsinks, and recalibrate the cooling system.

title: Windows 10 File Explorer shows 'Access is denied' for user home folder.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 File Explorer shows 'Access is denied' for user home folder.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Take ownership of the folder using the command prompt, check NTFS permissions recursively, ensure the user account has not been disabled, and run the system file checker.

title: VPN connection drops with 'Error 8024400F' related to Windows Update.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops with 'Error 8024400F' related to Windows Update.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable background data for Windows Update, add an exception in the firewall for the VPN client, and update the VPN client to the latest version.

title: Lenovo laptop webcam disabled in Device Manager but works in Settings.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop webcam disabled in Device Manager but works in Settings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the webcam driver, ensure the camera is not blocked by Windows Hello, check for specific Lenovo camera utility updates, and run the hardware diagnostics.

title: Dell desktop DVD drive not reading discs properly.
content:
Problem:
Dell desktop DVD drive not reading discs properly.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean the DVD drive lens with compressed air or a cleaning kit, update the optical drive drivers, check for IDE/SATA cable issues, and test the disc in another drive.

title: Windows 11 periodic blue screen with STOP code 0x0000219 (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT).
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 periodic blue screen with STOP code 0x0000219 (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run Windows Memory Diagnostic from Advanced Startup, check for excessive RAM usage, update all hardware drivers, and check for overheating of the memory modules.

title: Outlook 2020 stuck on loading icon for Exchange folder synchronization.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2020 stuck on loading icon for Exchange folder synchronization.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enable Exchange ActiveSync debugging, run the Microsoft Connectivity Analyzer for Outlook, disable cached Exchange mode, and check for large mailbox items.

title: M3 (Microsoft 365) Word document formatting corrupted after migration.
content:
Problem:
M3 (Microsoft 365) Word document formatting corrupted after migration.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use the 'Open and Repair' feature in Word, check for document corruption using the M365 Compliance Search, and restore from a recent version if available.

title: Teams meeting participant list shows 'Unknown' instead of names.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting participant list shows 'Unknown' instead of names.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Azure AD Connect synchronization for user attributes, ensure the Teams meeting policy allows participant listing, and clear the Teams client cache.

title: HP printer shows 'Paper Jam - Access the control panel' but no visible jam.
content:
Problem:
HP printer shows 'Paper Jam - Access the control panel' but no visible jam.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Follow the on-screen instructions to perform a deep cleaning of the printhead, remove the output tray and inspect for hidden paper paths, and contact HP support for further diagnosis.

title: Windows 10 network adapter IPv6 address causing connectivity issues.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 network adapter IPv6 address causing connectivity issues.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable IPv6 using netsh, configure the router to not assign IPv6 addresses, and check for updates to the Windows 10 operating system.

title: Dell laptop battery icon shows 'Service Required' but laptop powers on.
content:
Problem:
Dell laptop battery icon shows 'Service Required' but laptop powers on.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the battery health in the Dell Support Center, update the battery drivers, and calibrate the battery by fully charging and then discharging.

title: Lenovo laptop screen flickers or goes black intermittently during use.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop screen flickers or goes black intermittently during use.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the graphics drivers, check for display cable issues, and run the hardware diagnostics tool to test the screen and video subsystem.

title: Outlook 2019 keeps asking for credentials for a deleted Exchange account.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 keeps asking for credentials for a deleted Exchange account.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use the 'Manage Passwords' feature in Credential Manager, reset the MAPI profile, and manually remove the corrupted OST file.

title: M365 Azure AD Conditional Access Policy blocks all users from accessing Teams.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure AD Conditional Access Policy blocks all users from accessing Teams.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review and modify the Conditional Access Policy in Azure AD, ensure there are no conflicting policies, and test the policy with a test user account.

title: Windows 11 update KB5005592 causes high CPU usage by 'System' process.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update KB5005592 causes high CPU usage by 'System' process.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Roll back the update KB5005592, disable unnecessary startup processes, and run the Windows Memory Diagnostic to check for hardware issues.

title: Teams call audio drops out during calls with external participants.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio drops out during calls with external participants.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network jitter and latency using a network monitoring tool, prioritize Teams traffic in QoS, and ensure the Teams client is updated to the latest version.

title: HP laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects from Wi-Fi network.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects from Wi-Fi network.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the wireless driver, disable IPv6, and run the network troubleshooter to identify and resolve connectivity issues.

title: Windows 10 search index corruption causing slow search results.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 search index corruption causing slow search results.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild the index using Indexing Options, run the System File Checker (sfc /scannow), and check for hard drive errors using the Check Disk utility.

title: Dell monitor displays a green tint on images after connecting via DVI.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays a green tint on images after connecting via DVI.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the DVI cable for damage, update the graphics driver, and ensure the monitor's color calibration is reset to factory defaults.

title: Lenovo laptop touchpad not working after waking from sleep mode.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop touchpad not working after waking from sleep mode.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the touchpad driver, check the power settings to ensure touchpad is enabled, and run the hardware diagnostics tool.

title: Outlook 2021 keeps prompting to repair the profile on startup.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2021 keeps prompting to repair the profile on startup.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Manually repair the profile using the Inbox Repair Tool (scanpst.exe), create a new Outlook profile, and check for conflicts with antivirus software.

title: M365 Exchange Online Protection (EOP) not detecting spam emails correctly.
content:
Problem:
M365 Exchange Online Protection (EOP) not detecting spam emails correctly.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review the EOP settings and reputation filters, check for recent changes to spam filtering policies, and analyze the EOP report for false positives/negatives.

title: Windows 11 periodic restarts with error 'Stop code: 0x0000244E (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT)'.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 periodic restarts with error 'Stop code: 0x0000244E (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT)'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Windows Memory Diagnostic, check for excessive RAM usage, update the motherboard chipset drivers, and ensure the RAM is properly seated and not damaged.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing works but presenter cannot see their own screen.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing works but presenter cannot see their own screen.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the display settings in Windows to ensure screen mirroring is enabled, update the graphics drivers, and disable any screen saver or power-saving features.

title: HP printer shows 'Fuser Overheating' error during printing.
content:
Problem:
HP printer shows 'Fuser Overheating' error during printing.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Allow the printer to cool down, clean the fuser assembly, and check for obstructions in the paper path that might be causing re-heating.

title: Windows 10 periodic blue screen with STOP code 0x0000219 (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT) during gaming.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 periodic blue screen with STOP code 0x0000219 (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT) during gaming.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Increase virtual memory settings, update the graphics drivers, and check for overheating of the GPU during intensive tasks.

title: Dell desktop keyboard not responding to key presses randomly.
content:
Problem:
Dell desktop keyboard not responding to key presses randomly.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Test the keyboard with a USB extension cable to rule out port issues, update the motherboard chipset drivers, and check for static electricity discharge.

title: Lenovo laptop fingerprint reader not working with Windows Hello login.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop fingerprint reader not working with Windows Hello login.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the fingerprint reader driver, ensure the user has enrolled a working fingerprint, and check for Windows Hello service status in Task Manager.

title: Outlook 2022 keeps showing 'Waiting for server response' for calendar items.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2022 keeps showing 'Waiting for server response' for calendar items.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable cached Exchange mode, run the Microsoft Connectivity Analyzer, and check the server health in Exchange Admin Center.

title: M365 Azure AD Connect not replicating group membership changes.
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure AD Connect not replicating group membership changes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the Azure AD Connect configuration for attribute filtering, review the Active Directory replication status, and ensure outbound firewall ports are open for AD replication.

title: Windows 11 update KB5005593 causes high disk usage by the 'System' process.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update KB5005593 causes high disk usage by the 'System' process.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable the data collection and insights, run the Storage Sense to clean up temporary files, and roll back the update if the issue persists.

title: Teams meeting audio works for speaker but not for microphone.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting audio works for speaker but not for microphone.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the Teams audio device settings, ensure the microphone is not muted, and run the Teams audio troubleshooter.

title: HP laptop battery not charging despite power adapter working.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop battery not charging despite power adapter working.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the battery for physical damage, ensure the power adapter is the correct wattage, and run the Dell diagnostics to test the battery.

title: Windows 10 periodic restarts with error 'Stop code: 0x0000244E (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT)'.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 periodic restarts with error 'Stop code: 0x0000244E (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT)'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Windows Memory Diagnostic, check for excessive RAM usage, update the motherboard chipset drivers, and ensure the RAM is properly seated and not damaged.

title: Dell monitor displays a distorted image with scan lines after connecting via HDMI.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays a distorted image with scan lines after connecting via HDMI.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the HDMI cable for damage, update the graphics driver, and ensure the monitor's firmware is up to date.

title: Lenovo laptop webcam works in camera apps but not in Teams.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop webcam works in camera apps but not in Teams.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the Teams client, ensure the Teams camera settings are configured correctly, and check for any application-level restrictions on camera access.

title: Outlook 2016 keeps prompting for re-authentication during send/receive.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 keeps prompting for re-authentication during send/receive.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild the Outlook data file cache, disable roaming profiles or check Roaming Profiles configuration, and clear the Windows Vault credential store.

title: M365 Azure AD Conditional Access Policy requires multi-factor authentication (MFA) but users report 'App not register...
content:
Problem:
M365 Azure AD Conditional Access Policy requires multi-factor authentication (MFA) but users report 'App not registered'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Register the application in Azure AD, ensure the app has the necessary permissions, and check the Conditional Access Policy configuration for the application.

title: Windows 11 update KB5005594 causes the Start Menu to disappear on login.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 update KB5005594 causes the Start Menu to disappear on login.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Roll back the update KB5005594, run the System File Checker, and check for conflicts with third-party themes or shell replacements.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing works but the presenter's screen is black.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing works but the presenter's screen is black.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Ensure the presenter's display is not in power saving mode, update the graphics drivers, and check for any screen saver or lock settings that might trigger during sharing.

title: HP printer shows 'Ink Cartridge Error' for the cyan cartridge even though it is new.
content:
Problem:
HP printer shows 'Ink Cartridge Error' for the cyan cartridge even though it is new.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean the printhead, calibrate the print head, and ensure the new cartridge is genuine and properly installed.

title: Windows 10 periodic blue screen with STOP code 0x0000219 (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT) during video playback.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 periodic blue screen with STOP code 0x0000219 (MEMORY_MANAGEMENT) during video playback.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the graphics drivers, check for overheating of the GPU, and ensure the system has sufficient cooling during intensive tasks.

title: Dell laptop wireless adapter not connecting to 5GHz networks.
content:
Problem:
Dell laptop wireless adapter not connecting to 5GHz networks.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the wireless driver, check the Windows network adapter settings for 5GHz band configuration, and ensure the router is broadcasting the 5GHz network.

title: Lenovo laptop touchpad gestures not working after installing new software.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop touchpad gestures not working after installing new software.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:

content:

content:

content:

Ensure all users have the latest Teams client, check for display driver issues, and test with different sharing methods.

content:

Roll back the driver to a previous version, update to the latest driver from the manufacturer's website, and check for conflicts.

content:

Outlook 2016 stuck on 'Loading Profile' during startup

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Repair the Outlook profile using the Inbox Repair tool, create a new profile, and disable add-ins temporarily.

title: M365 Azure AD Identity Protection not detecting sign-ins from new devices
content:

Check for Azure AD Connect configuration, ensure device registration is enabled, and test with a sign-in from a new device.

title: Teams call audio feedback occurs only during screen sharing
content:

Disable screen sharing, update audio drivers, and check for microphone proximity issues.

title: Dell monitor power light flashes when trying to turn off
content:

Dell monitor power light flashes when trying to turn off

Check for loose cable connections, ensure the monitor is properly powered, and contact Dell support for further diagnosis.

title: Windows Update fails with error 0x80070002.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update fails with error 0x80070002.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run 'net stop wuauserv', 'net start wuauserv', clear the SoftwareDistribution folder, reset Windows Update components via DISM and sfc /scannow.

title: M365 login fails with 'Account disabled' error.
content:
Problem:
M365 login fails with 'Account disabled' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Azure AD user account status (enabled/disabled), verify MFA is configured, check for service health issues in Microsoft 365 status.

title: Teams meeting audio drops frequently.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting audio drops frequently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check headset/microphone drivers, test audio output/input devices, verify microphone permissions in Teams settings and Windows, disable background apps.

title: Outlook stuck on loading spin wheel.
content:
Problem:
Outlook stuck on loading spin wheel.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Repair Outlook profile using 'Mail > Add Account > Not working > Repair', disable conflicting add-ins via safe mode, rebuild OST cache if corrupt.

title: Laptop won't boot, stuck on black screen.
content:
Problem:
Laptop won't boot, stuck on black screen.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enter recovery environment (Windows Recovery), run startup repair, check for memory dump errors, verify bootloader integrity.

title: VPN connection drops after 15 minutes.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops after 15 minutes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check firewall rules allowing VPN traffic, verify IKEv2 and SSTP protocols are configured in Windows Defender Firewall, check VPN server logs for client disconnects.

title: Network drive mapping fails with 'Access Denied' error.
content:
Problem:
Network drive mapping fails with 'Access Denied' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Map drive with admin credentials if needed, check file permissions on the server, verify the user's roaming/deferred roaming policy settings.

title: Dell laptop battery drains extremely fast.
content:
Problem:
Dell laptop battery drains extremely fast.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check power plan settings (High Performance vs Balanced), run battery calibration cycle, update Dell support drivers, check for rogue startup items.

title: HP printer shows 'USB not found' error.
content:
Problem:
HP printer shows 'USB not found' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reconnect the USB cable, ensure the printer firmware is updated, check if the USB port is functioning correctly on other devices, reinstall the printer drivers.

title: Lenovo T490 webcam disabled by BIOS.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 webcam disabled by BIOS.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enter BIOS/UEFI setup during boot, navigate to Security > USB/Laptop Settings, enable integrated camera, save and exit.

title: Windows Defender mistakenly quarantined critical files.
content:
Problem:
Windows Defender mistakenly quarantined critical files.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use System File Checker (sfc /scannow) to identify and restore, perform DISM cleanup-image /restorehealth, restore from known good backup if necessary.

title: M365 OneDrive sync fails with error 0x80070520.
content:
Problem:
M365 OneDrive sync fails with error 0x80070520.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network connectivity to Microsoft 365 data centers, disable any third-party antivirus temporarily, reset OneDrive context menu handlers, reconfigure OneDrive sync.

title: Teams screen sharing works but audio sharing fails.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing works but audio sharing fails.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Ensure the audio driver is up to date, check Teams audio device selection during sharing, test sharing audio from the operating system mixer.

title: Outlook email sending works but receiving fails.
content:
Problem:
Outlook email sending works but receiving fails.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Exchange connectivity with Test Connectivity in Outlook, verify POP/IMAP settings if applicable, check for junk mail filtering on the server.

title: VPN client prompts for credentials repeatedly.
content:
Problem:
VPN client prompts for credentials repeatedly.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Add the VPN server certificate to the trusted root certificate store, check for IP conflicts, reset the VPN adapter configuration.

title: Windows 10/11 activation error 0xC004F016.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10/11 activation error 0xC004F016.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run 'slmgr.vbs /dlv' to check activation status, use 'slmgr.vbs /rearm' if needed, download and install the correct volume license key from Azure AD.

content:
Problem:
M365 Defender alert shows suspicious login from unusual location.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review sign-in logs in Azure AD, enforce multi-factor authentication for the user, investigate if the location is a known threat actor or phishing attempt.

title: Teams chat messages send but don't appear in the history.
content:
Problem:
Teams chat messages send but don't appear in the history.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Teams data storage policies, clear Teams cache and data, rejoin the affected team channels.

title: Network IP address conflict detected by Windows.
content:
Problem:
Network IP address conflict detected by Windows.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Release and renew IP address (ipconfig /release, ipconfig /renew), check for unauthorized devices on the network, configure static IPs for critical devices.

title: HP laptop fan noise increases during normal use.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop fan noise increases during normal use.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean internal dust from fan and heatsink, ensure thermal paste is applied correctly (if DIY), monitor CPU temperatures using HWMonitor.

title: Lenovo docking station ports intermittently lose connectivity.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo docking station ports intermittently lose connectivity.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update docking station firmware, check for driver conflicts, try connecting peripherals directly to the laptop without the dock.

content:
Problem:
Windows Update installs but fails to complete integration.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth, then run sfc /scannow, check for pending driver updates that might conflict with integration.

title: M3leshoot remote assistance session times out.
content:
Problem:
M3leshoot remote assistance session times out.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check firewall rules allowing port 57777 inbound, ensure the remote PC has Remote Desktop enabled and configured correctly, verify network bandwidth and latency.

title: Teams call audio is choppy during meetings.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio is choppy during meetings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network bandwidth using tools like Speedtest.net, disable any bandwidth-intensive applications, ensure Teams is updated to the latest version.

title: Outlook calendar invites show 'Cannot open the file' error.
content:
Problem:
Outlook calendar invites show 'Cannot open the file' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild the Outlook OST file using 'File > Options > Advanced > Offline Availability', check for large calendar items causing corruption, disable conflicting antivirus software.

title: Dell monitor screen flickers at startup.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor screen flickers at startup.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the video cable connection (HDMI/DP/VGA), test with another monitor if available, update graphics drivers, check for monitor firmware updates.

content:

Windows 11 TPM status shows 'Not Ready' for Bitlocker.
