title: Windows login loop due to corrupted profile.
content:
Problem:
Windows login loop due to corrupted profile.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Perform a system restore to a previous point, disable roaming profiles if applicable, rebuild the profile using Sysinternals tools, or perform an in-place upgrade.

title: Failed Windows update installation due to error 0x80070005.
content:
Problem:
Failed Windows update installation due to error 0x80070005.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Windows Update Troubleshooter, check for disk errors, free up disk space, disable security software temporarily, and reset Windows Update components using DISM and SFC.

title: Print spooler service crashes on Windows 10.
content:
Problem:
Print spooler service crashes on Windows 10.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Stop and restart the Print Spooler service, clear the entire spool folder, re-add printers, check for conflicting drivers, and ensure system file integrity.

title: Domain authentication failure on Windows 11 machines.
content:
Problem:
Domain authentication failure on Windows 11 machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify network connectivity to the domain controller, check DNS resolution, ensure correct computer account status, run netdiag /full, and validate group policy settings.

title: Windows Update stuck on downloading for hours.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update stuck on downloading for hours.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Windows Update Standalone Installer (WUSA), reset the Windows Update components via PowerShell, check for pending reboots, and disable background smart app updates.

title: Remote desktop connection timed out for users in specific OU.
content:
Problem:
Remote desktop connection timed out for users in specific OU.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify RDP firewall rules on both client and server, check group policy restrictions for the affected OU, ensure RDP-Tcp port is open on the server, and test connectivity using mstsc /admin.

title: PowerShell execution policy blocks script execution.
content:
Problem:
PowerShell execution policy blocks script execution.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Modify the execution policy via Set-ExecutionPolicy, bypass using PowerShell with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, or configure group policy to allow script execution.

title: VPN client disconnects after 15 minutes despite idle timeout settings.
content:
Problem:
VPN client disconnects after 15 minutes despite idle timeout settings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check VPN client configuration for idle disconnect settings, verify split tunneling rules, inspect firewall rules, and test with different clients like Cisco AnyConnect or OpenVPN.

title: Corporate WiFi network keeps disconnecting Windows laptops.
content:
Problem:
Corporate WiFi network keeps disconnecting Windows laptops.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Forget the network, perform NCB reset, check for rogue APs, test with different network profiles (Public/Private), and check DHCP lease renewals.

title: Outlook add-in causes slow performance and crashes.
content:
Problem:
Outlook add-in causes slow performance and crashes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable third-party add-ins in Safe Mode, update or reinstall the problematic add-in, check for conflicts via the Trust Center settings, and clear the add-in cache.

title: M365 license activation stuck in pending state.
content:

M365 license activation stuck in pending state.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reassign and immediately activate the license in Azure AD, check for compliance rules blocking activation, verify user account status, and ensure proper license assignment.

content:

Teams meeting scheduled with wrong time zone.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Adjust the user's calendar time zone settings in M365, modify the scheduled meeting properties, ensure the Teams client time is correct, and check group policy for default time zone.

content:

content:

title: HP printer displays 'Replace toner' intermittently despite toner levels being adequate.
content:
Problem:
HP printer displays 'Replace toner' intermittently despite toner levels being adequate.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean the toner sensor contacts, recalibrate the printer, and check for firmware updates. If issue persists, consider replacing the toner cartridge.

title: Windows Update fails with error code 0x80070002.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update fails with error code 0x80070002.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run 'net stop wuauserv' and 'net start wuauserv', reset Windows Update components with DISM and cleanup the SoftwareDistribution folder.

title: M365 login fails with 'We trust this device at a lower security level'.
content:
Problem:
M365 login fails with 'We trust this device at a lower security level'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Add the device to Azure AD trusted devices, ensure BitLocker is configured correctly, and check device compliance policies.

title: Teams screen sharing stops working mid-presentation.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing stops working mid-presentation.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Sign out and sign back into Teams, reset meeting add-in permissions, and clear the Teams cache from the local app data folder.

title: Outlook profile syncs emails incorrectly across devices.
content:
Problem:
Outlook profile syncs emails incorrectly across devices.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify Active Directory distribution group memberships, reset the Offline Address Book (OAB), and force a directory synchronization cycle.

title: Laptop battery drains rapidly despite settings.
content:
Problem:
Laptop battery drains rapidly despite settings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update battery drivers, disable fast charging in BIOS, calibrate the battery by letting it discharge fully, and check for rogue background apps.

title: VPN connection drops frequently on Windows 10/11.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops frequently on Windows 10/11.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the VPN client software, check for conflicting firewall rules, reset the Winsock catalog, and disable IPv6 temporarily.

title: Network discovery is disabled on corporate machines.
content:
Problem:
Network discovery is disabled on corporate machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Configure Windows Firewall to allow file and printer sharing, enable 'Network Location Settings' to 'Home Network' or 'Work Network', and run 'netsh int ip reset'.

title: Dell Optiplex mouse cursor jumps erratically.
content:
Problem:
Dell Optiplex mouse cursor jumps erratically.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reinstall the mouse driver, disable USB selective suspend in power options, check for electromagnetic interference nearby, and run hardware diagnostics.

title: HP LaserJet printer shows 'memory full' error.
content:
Problem:
HP LaserJet printer shows 'memory full' error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Increase the Java heap space for the print driver, clear the printer's internal memory by resetting counters, and update the printer firmware.

title: Lenovo T490 webcam shows distorted image.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 webcam shows distorted image.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the Intel RealSense driver, recalibrate the camera using Windows settings, disable any third-party camera utilities, and check for physical obstructions.

title: Windows 11 activation fails with error 0x80072EE2.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 activation fails with error 0x80072EE2.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-run the activation troubleshooter, check for group policy overrides, ensure the system is clean installed, and verify licensing with Volume Licensing Service.

title: M365 OneDrive sync fails with error 0x80070527.
content:
Problem:
M365 OneDrive sync fails with error 0x80070527.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for antivirus interference, disable CDN for the user's tenant, reset the sync app, and ensure the user has the latest Azure AD Connect client.

title: Teams call audio drops every 5 minutes.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio drops every 5 minutes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check headset compatibility with Teams, disable audio enhancements in sound settings, update Teams to the latest version, and test with different endpoints.

title: Outlook stuck on 'Connecting' for Exchange Online.
content:
Problem:
Outlook stuck on 'Connecting' for Exchange Online.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Repair the Outlook profile using 'inetcpl.cpl' settings, disable add-ins, reset OST file permissions, and check for large mailbox issues.

title: M3leshoot USB driver for HP printer keeps failing to install.
content:
Problem:
M3leshoot USB driver for HP printer keeps failing to install.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use the HP Solution Center for driver installation, disable driver signature enforcement, manually install the WHQL certified driver from the HP website, and check for conflicting drivers.

title: VPN users cannot access internal M365 resources.
content:
Problem:
VPN users cannot access internal M365 resources.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify split tunneling configuration, check firewall rules for M365 ports, test DNS resolution from the VPN client, and confirm user access policies.

title: Network adapter driver conflicts causing system crashes.
content:
Problem:
Network adapter driver conflicts causing system crashes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Uninstall the network adapter driver completely, install the latest driver from manufacturer's site, disable legacy network adapters in Device Manager, and run memtest86.

title: Dell monitor displays 'Input Signal Not Detected'.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays 'Input Signal Not Detected'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the physical connection to the port, test with another cable/monitor, update the monitor's firmware if available, and check for EDID issues.

title: Lenovo docking station ports intermittently lose power.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo docking station ports intermittently lose power.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-seat all internal cables in the docking station, update the docking station firmware, disable power-saving features in Lenovo Vantage, and test with different peripherals.

title: Windows 10 update stuck at 80% for hours.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 update stuck at 80% for hours.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run 'dism /online /cleanup-image /restorehealth', use System File Checker (sfc /scannow), disable Windows Update backgrounding, and manually download the required update.

title: M365 SharePoint site appears corrupted with missing files.
content:
Problem:
M365 SharePoint site appears corrupted with missing files.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for virus/malware in the site, restore from recycle bin or previous versions, use Azure Advanced Threat Protection logs, and verify content database integrity.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing works for presenter but not attendees.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing works for presenter but not attendees.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check attendee permissions in the meeting options, verify the presenting user's device permissions, reset Teams permissions, and check for conflicting add-ins.

Problem:
Outlook 2019 add-in causes constant crashes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable all add-ins except essentials, repair the Office installation, check for known issues in the Microsoft Support Lifecycle, and update the problematic add-in.

content:

HP touchpad unresponsive during Windows 11 login.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:

Windows 11 Action Center notifications constantly pop up.

Adjust notification settings via Settings > System > Notifications, disable 'Show notifications from the following apps', and clear the Action Center cache.

content:

Lenovo XClarity Essentials login fails with certificate error.

Problem:
Windows 10 update KB4056894 causes blue screen of death.

content:
Problem:
M365 Exchange Online mail flow blocked for external senders.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check transport rules, verify MX record configuration, test mail flow via Test Connectivity in the portal, and check spam filter settings.

content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 stuck on 'Verifying signatures' indefinitely.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable digital signature add-ins, update the Cryptography API: Next Generation (CAPICOM), re-enable certificate auto-discovery, and run 'outlook /cleanprofile'.

content:
Problem:
HP USB security key not detected during login.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-enroll the security key in Azure AD, update the FIDO2 driver, check for compatibility with Windows Hello, and test with different USB ports.

title: Windows 11 file history backup fails with access denied.
content:
Problem:
Windows 11 file history backup fails with access denied.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Adjust file permissions for the backup folder, check for roaming user profiles issues, disable Windows Defender temporarily, and verify system protected path.

title: M365 Teams call shows 'The user is currently in a meeting' for absent users.
content:
Problem:
M365 Teams call shows 'The user is currently in a meeting' for absent users.

Re-pair the stylus, update the Lenovo Active Pen driver, recalibrate the touch screen via Lenovo Vantage, and check for driver conflicts.

content:
Problem:
M365 Azure AD password writeback not syncing changes.

content:
Problem:
Outlook 2016 autodiscover fails with HTTP 404 error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:

title: Teams call audio echo during internal calls only.
content:
Problem:
Teams call audio echo during internal calls only.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC) in Teams audio settings, check for speakerphone usage, test with wired headsets, and verify audio device properties.

content:
Problem:
HP printer shows 'Paper Jam' but no visible paper in tray.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Visually inspect all paper paths for hidden jam, use the 'Service' tab in the HP driver to clear a virtual jam, update the printer firmware, and check for firmware updates.

content:
Problem:
Windows 11 event log error 'A recent hardware profile has changed'.

Run 'powercfg /setacvalue scavenge 0' and 'powercfg /setacvalue hiberboot 0', check for hardware changes, and run system file checker.

content:
Problem:
M365 OneDrive for Business sync conflicts with local files.

content:

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check system event logs for memory or driver issues, update Teams client to the latest version, scan for conflicting kernel-mode drivers, and run a memory diagnostic test.

title: VPN client disconnects frequently after authenticating with Azure AD.
content:
Problem:
VPN client disconnects frequently after authenticating with Azure AD.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify the Azure AD certificate validity and revocation status, check the VPN appliance's Azure AD Connect Health integration logs, ensure the VPN tunnel IPsec settings are correct, and test client-side certificate binding.

title: Outlook add-in causes M365 mailbox overload and slow performance.
content:
Problem:
Outlook add-in causes M365 mailbox overload and slow performance.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable the problematic add-in, identify and remove corrupted OST/NAS files, adjust M365 mailbox size limits, and configure add-in permissions to restrict data access.

title: Teams call quality degrades during network peak hours.
content:
Problem:
Teams call quality degrades during network peak hours.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Perform QoS mapping for audio and video, check network bandwidth usage with tools like Wireshark, prioritize Teams traffic using a network controller, and verify firewall rules allow necessary ports.

title: HP laptop driver rollback fails for integrated graphics on Windows 11 upgrade.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop driver rollback fails for integrated graphics on Windows 11 upgrade.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Download the specific legacy driver version from the HP support website matching the OS, disable signature enforcement temporarily, use Device Manager to force the driver installation, and check for BIOS updates.

title: Dell monitor displays incorrect colors in critical design software.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays incorrect colors in critical design software.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the monitor driver from Dell Support, recalibrate the display using manufacturer tools, check for color profile corruption in Windows settings, and ensure the graphics card driver is up-to-date.

title: Windows 10 update fails with error 0x80070422 during installation.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 update fails with error 0x80070422 during installation.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for pending reboots, disable Windows Update background downloads via Services, run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image, reset Windows Update components, and verify system time synchronization.

title: M365 user unable to authenticate via Azure AD on company laptops.
content:
Problem:
M365 user unable to authenticate via Azure AD on company laptops.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify the user's account status in Azure AD, check Conditional Access policies, test the device trust status, and ensure the computer has the latest Windows security updates.

title: Teams audio intermittently disconnects during calls in the office.
content:
Problem:
Teams audio intermittently disconnects during calls in the office.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-register the Teams application with the tenant, update Teams client to the latest version, check firewall rules for UDP ports 50000-50008, and validate network adapter drivers.

title: Outlook 2019 profile corruption prevents email access.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 profile corruption prevents email access.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Create a new Outlook profile, repair the current profile via Instrustools, check for conflicting device drivers, and verify the user's mailbox is not quarantined or disabled.

title: VPN connection drops frequently after 30 minutes.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops frequently after 30 minutes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Adjust the VPN client idle timeout settings, check for background processes consuming bandwidth, update the VPN client software, and review firewall rules for outbound traffic.

title: Dell monitor displays 'No Signal' after recent BIOS update.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor displays 'No Signal' after recent BIOS update.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the monitor's physical connection, update the monitor's firmware if available, reset the monitor's internal EDID database via the manufacturer's utility, or replace the video cable.

title: HP laptop Wi-Fi adapter drivers reinstall on every boot after driver update.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop Wi-Fi adapter drivers reinstall on every boot after driver update.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Dell/HP Precision utilities (where applicable) to reinstall network drivers correctly, disable driver signature enforcement temporarily, and ensure the OS driver model matches the hardware.

title: Lenovo T490 Bluetooth mouse disconnects sporadically during meetings.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 Bluetooth mouse disconnects sporadically during meetings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-pair the mouse, update the ThinkPad Bluetooth driver, disable power-saving modes on the adapter, and check for electromagnetic interference sources near the laptop.

title: Corporate network DNS lookup fails for internal resources but works for public sites.
content:
Problem:
Corporate network DNS lookup fails for internal resources but works for public sites.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the primary and secondary DNS server entries in TCP/IP properties, verify DNS forwarder and root hints on the local DNS server, test nslookup commands, and check HOST file modifications.

title: M365 Teams screen sharing works externally but not internally to corporate resources.
content:
Problem:
M365 Teams screen sharing works externally but not internally to corporate resources.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Confirm the user has 'screen sharing' permissions in Teams, check corporate firewall rules for outbound RDP/PCoIP traffic, and ensure the user's device screen sharing policy allows internal sharing.

title: Windows login loop after domain profile corruption.
content:
Problem:
Windows login loop after domain profile corruption.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run Sysinternals Autoruns to disable conflicting startup items, rebuild the system hive from a backup, reset the machine password via Active Directory, and rejoin the domain with a new profile.

title: M365 Outlook email sync fails with 'Error 0x80072EE7' on multiple machines.
content:
Problem:
M365 Outlook email sync fails with 'Error 0x80072EE7' on multiple machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reset the M365 service connection point (SCP), clear the Outlook OST cache, reconfigure Exchange ActiveSync, and verify the Autodiscover service URI in Azure AD.

title: Teams meeting screen sharing black screens intermittently.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting screen sharing black screens intermittently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the Intel/AMD graphics driver, disable third-party screen sharing extensions, reset Teams microphones and camera permissions, and check firewall rules for UDP ports 5000-5002.

title: VPN client drops connection after 15 minutes despite valid credentials.
content:
Problem:
VPN client drops connection after 15 minutes despite valid credentials.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check firewall rules for deep packet inspection, disable IKEv2 protocol forcing SSTP, verify certificate validity on the VPN server, and clear the client's Windows Cryptography cache.

title: HP laptop battery drains rapidly even when plugged in.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop battery drains rapidly even when plugged in.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run HP Support Assistant battery diagnostics, check for rogue power profiles, replace the battery if flagged, and disable hibernation to prevent file system corruption.

title: Lenovo T490 wireless adapter intermittently disconnects during high CPU load.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 wireless adapter intermittently disconnects during high CPU load.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update the Realtek driver to latest version, disable Wi-Fi power save features, reset Windows 802.11 wireless registry settings, and re-seating the wireless antenna.

title: Domain-joined Dell desktop shows 'Network location unknown' in File Explorer.
content:
Problem:
Domain-joined Dell desktop shows 'Network location unknown' in File Explorer.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run 'netsh winsock reset' and 'ipconfig /flushdns', re-register the MNET service, check DHCP leases for active leases, and repair the network location database with 'lodctr /r'.

title: M365 Teams instant messages not sending with 'Error 0x80070522' on a single workstation.
content:
Problem:
M365 Teams instant messages not sending with 'Error 0x80070522' on a single workstation.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-register MsMpEng and MsCrmPlugin services, clear the Teams container registry keys, reset the Teams profile, and repair the Microsoft Graph client context.

title: Windows 10 update stuck at 'Downloading' for 48 hours on a fleet of 500 machines.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 update stuck at 'Downloading' for 48 hours on a fleet of 500 machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Windows Update service status and dependencies, clear the CBS cache, disable network access to Windows Update, and deploy a group policy override for the stuck update.

title: Outlook 2019 calendar invites silently disappear from shared resources.
content:
Problem:
Outlook 2019 calendar invites silently disappear from shared resources.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check resource mailbox calendar permissions, disable overlapping meeting prevention, run 'eseutil /r' on the Exchange database, and reset the Outlook cache permissions.

title: Corporate VPN tunnel establishes but RDP connections fail with 'Connection refused' for internal resources.
content:
Problem:
Corporate VPN tunnel establishes but RDP connections fail with 'Connection refused' for internal resources.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the VPN split tunnel policy, disable the VPN's IPsec tunnel mode, add internal resources to the VPN allow list, and verify the host file entries for the VPN gateway.

title: Dell monitor shows 'Input signal not detected' after waking from sleep mode.
content:
Problem:
Dell monitor shows 'Input signal not detected' after waking from sleep mode.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Cycle the monitor's power, update the monitor firmware via Dell Diagnostics, check for DisplayPort/HDMI cable degradation, and re-seat the internal I2C connectors.

title: Windows Update fails with error code 80070002.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update fails with error code 80070002.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image, then SFC /scannow, and check Windows Update logs for more details.

title: M365 user unable to reset password.
content:
Problem:
M365 user unable to reset password.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Azure AD admin center to reset password, check multi-factor authentication settings, and ensure account is not locked out.

title: Microsoft Teams meeting audio drops frequently.
content:
Problem:
Microsoft Teams meeting audio drops frequently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check network latency, update Teams client, test audio devices with external apps, and review firewall rules.

title: Outlook email not syncing with Exchange.
content:
Problem:
Outlook email not syncing with Exchange.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run Microsoft Remote Connectivity Analyzer, check Autodiscover settings, reset Outlook profile, and verify certificate trust.

title: Missing printer driver on Dell laptop.
content:
Problem:
Missing printer driver on Dell laptop.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Download and install latest driver from manufacturer website, use Dell Support Assistant, and update firmware.

title: VPN connection drops every 10 minutes.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops every 10 minutes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check VPN client logs, verify server certificate validity, test network latency, and update client software.

title: IP address conflict on corporate network.
content:
Problem:
IP address conflict on corporate network.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Release and renew IP address using ipconfig /release and ipconfig /renew, check DHCP server logs, and assign static IP if necessary.

title: Lenovo ThinkPad screen flickers intermittently.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo ThinkPad screen flickers intermittently.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update graphics driver, run hardware diagnostics from Lenovo Vantage, check for overheating, and recalibrate display.

title: Windows 10 update stuck at 50%.
content:
Problem:
Windows 10 update stuck at 50%.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable Windows Defender temporarily, check for pending system updates, use System File Checker, and restart installation.

title: M365 compliance policy blocks document sharing.
content:
Problem:
M365 compliance policy blocks document sharing.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Review and modify compliance policies in Microsoft 365, ensure user has necessary permissions, and check data loss prevention rules.

title: Microsoft Teams screen sharing not working.
content:
Problem:
Microsoft Teams screen sharing not working.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update Teams client, check group policy for sharing restrictions, test with different applications, and ensure network permissions.

title: Outlook calendar invites not auto-forwarding.
content:
Problem:
Outlook calendar invites not auto-forwarding.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check calendar permissions, review forwarding settings, use Microsoft 365 compliance center to audit, and repair profile.

title: Graphics driver crash in Windows after gaming.
content:
Problem:
Graphics driver crash in Windows after gaming.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Roll back driver to previous version, update to latest driver, disable GPU acceleration in settings, and check for overheating.

title: VPN authentication fails with BAD_CERTIFICATE error.
content:
Problem:
VPN authentication fails with BAD_CERTIFICATE error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reinstall VPN client, check certificate validity dates, import new certificate if expired, and verify trust chain.

title: Network DNS not resolving internal domains.
content:
Problem:
Network DNS not resolving internal domains.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Flush DNS cache with ipconfig /flushdns, check HOSTS file for errors, test DNS with nslookup, and verify DHCP settings.

title: Windows registry key corrupted causing blue screen.
content:
Problem:
Windows registry key corrupted causing blue screen.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Boot into safe mode, restore corrupted registry key from backup, use regedit to repair, and scan with chkdsk.

title: M365 license nearing expiration for user accounts.
content:
Problem:
M365 license nearing expiration for user accounts.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Azure Cost Management to identify expiring licenses, purchase new ones, and communicate with users on renewal.

title: Teams call recording shows silence.
content:
Problem:
Teams call recording shows silence.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Ensure microphone permissions, update Teams client, check audio levels, and test recording with external app.

title: Outlook delegation settings not working.
content:
Problem:
Outlook delegation settings not working.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Active Directory Users and Computers to set permissions, check recipient policies, and run Outlook repair.

title: HP Elitebook fan noise increases during use.
content:
Problem:
HP Elitebook fan noise increases during use.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update thermal driver, clean dust from vents, monitor temperature with HP Support Tools, and replace fan if needed.

title: Windows Update fails with error 0x80070005.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update fails with error 0x80070005.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run the Windows Update troubleshooter, reset Windows Update components via DISM and sfc /scannow, clear the software distribution folder, and check for pending reboots.

title: M365 login fails with 'We trust this device at a lower security level'.
content:
Problem:
M365 login fails with 'We trust this device at a lower security level'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
On the device, re-enroll the Azure AD joined device, reset the TPM, and ensure BitLocker is not preventing the login.

title: Teams screen sharing shows 'sharing not enabled'.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing shows 'sharing not enabled'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check Teams meeting policy settings in the M365 admin center, ensure user has the Teams license, and clear Teams app cache and data.

title: Outlook cannot open a specific PST file with error 0x800CCC0F.
content:
Problem:
Outlook cannot open a specific PST file with error 0x800CCC0F.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use ScanPST.exe (Outlook Inbox Repair Tool) to repair the PST, try opening with a different Outlook profile, or restore from backup if repair fails.

title: Laptop UEFI BIOS update stuck at 10% on Dell XPS.
content:
Problem:
Laptop UEFI BIOS update stuck at 10% on Dell XPS.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Interrupt the update using the Dell Support Assistant, enter UEFI setup, disable Secure Boot, and retry the update from a stable network connection.

title: VPN connection drops every 5 minutes on company VPN client.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops every 5 minutes on company VPN client.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for background applications using the network (like BitTorrent), disable IPv6 protocols, reset the VPN client, and update the VPN client software.

title: Network discovery is off preventing file sharing on corporate network.
content:
Problem:
Network discovery is off preventing file sharing on corporate network.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enable File and Printer Sharing in Windows Defender Firewall, set network location to Home or Work, and ensure the relevant file sharing protocols (SMBv1 or SMBv3) are enabled.

title: HP LaserJet printer shows 'Replace toner' even with new cartridge.
content:
Problem:
HP LaserJet printer shows 'Replace toner' even with new cartridge.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clean the toner cartridge sensors with a soft electronics cleaning cloth, remove and reinsert the carriage assembly, and check for firmware updates for the printer.

title: Lenovo T490 won't boot from USB drive for OS reinstallation.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 won't boot from USB drive for OS reinstallation.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Enter BIOS/UEFI, disable Secure Boot and Fast Boot, set USB boot priority, ensure the USB drive is formatted as FAT32, and try a different USB port or cable.

title: Corporate VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' using certificate-based auth.
content:
Problem:
Corporate VPN client shows 'Authentication failed' using certificate-based auth.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check certificate validity dates and trust chain, reset the VPN IKEv2 settings via Group Policy or manual registry edit, and ensure the VPN server's root certificate is trusted on the client.

title: Windows activation error 0x80070005 on domain-joined machines.
content:
Problem:
Windows activation error 0x80070005 on domain-joined machines.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-run sysprep with correct MAK key, ensure KMS server is reachable via DFS replication, and validate licensing ports.

title: M365 profile corruption causing Outlook not to load.
content:
Problem:
M365 profile corruption causing Outlook not to load.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Force re-sync AD Connect attributes, reset user's M365 mailbox profile via PowerShell, and repair Outlook data files using SCANSTAT.

title: Persistent VPN connection drops on company network.
content:
Problem:
Persistent VPN connection drops on company network.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check firewall rules for split tunneling, verify IKEv2/MQVPN IPsec policies, and ensure domain-joined clients have updated VPN client profiles.

title: Teams meeting audio uses speakerphone constantly.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting audio uses speakerphone constantly.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Re-register Teams calling components, check system audio device permissions, and reset audio graph endpoints via PowerShell.

title: Corporate VPN client fails to connect after Windows update.
content:
Problem:
Corporate VPN client fails to connect after Windows update.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reinstall VPN client with latest drivers, check for conflicting security software, and validate certificate trust chain for the VPN server.

title: VPN connection drops frequently during peak hours.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops frequently during peak hours.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check VPN tunnel health, review QoS rules, clear IKEv2 cache, and verify firewall rules on client and server.

title: M365 login delay exceeds 2 minutes for all users.
content:
Problem:
M365 login delay exceeds 2 minutes for all users.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clear Azure AD Connect cache, restart AD FS services, check transitive trust, and verify domain controller replication.

title: Teams audio crackles during calls on specific hardware.
content:
Problem:
Teams audio crackles during calls on specific hardware.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update audio drivers, disable acoustic echo cancellation, test audio endpoints, and reset Teams audio settings.

title: Outlook PST file inaccessible with error code 0x800CCCCE4.
content:
Problem:
Outlook PST file inaccessible with error code 0x800CCCCE4.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use SCANPST.exe to repair the PST, enable Outlook logging, check disk permissions, and increase the PST storage limit.

title: HP laptop wireless adapter intermittently disables after waking from sleep.
content:
Problem:
HP laptop wireless adapter intermittently disables after waking from sleep.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update wireless driver, disable power-saving features, reset Windows network stacks, and check for BIOS updates.

title: Network speed tests show 100Mbps down but actual download speed is 10Mbps.
content:
Problem:
Network speed tests show 100Mbps down but actual download speed is 10Mbps.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check for duplex mismatch, verify port speed settings, test with different cables, and check for network congestion.

title: Lenovo T490 BIOS update fails with a hardware compatibility error.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo T490 BIOS update fails with a hardware compatibility error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Lenovo's dedicated BIOS flashing utility, ensure stable power source, disable secure boot, and consult Lenovo support.

title: Windows Update fails to install critical updates.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update fails to install critical updates.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check disk space and free storage, disable conflicting security software, run the Windows Update troubleshooter, and execute DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image followed by sfc /scannow.

title: Users cannot authenticate to Microsoft 365 with multi-factor authentication.
content:
Problem:
Users cannot authenticate to Microsoft 365 with multi-factor authentication.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify user account status and license assignments, check conditional access policies, test M365 connectivity from a trusted network, and reset MFA registration if necessary.

title: Lenovo laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects.
content:
Problem:
Lenovo laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update wireless driver to the latest version, reset Windows networking stack using netsh, check for interference from other devices, and recalibrate the wireless module through Lenovo Vantage.

title: User locked out of Windows desktop after too many password attempts.
content:
Problem:
User locked out of Windows desktop after too many password attempts.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Reset user account password via local administrator or SAM account, clear failed password attempts from the security event log (Event Viewer), and ensure account is enabled.

title: Windows PC experiencing severe performance lag (high CPU/RAM usage).
content:
Problem:
Windows PC experiencing severe performance lag (high CPU/RAM usage).

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Use Task Manager/System Monitor to identify resource-hogging processes, check for malware/virus infections, run disk defragmentation (for HDDs) or optimize SSD, and verify for pending Windows updates.

title: Outlook profile corruption prevents email access on corporate laptops.
content:
Problem:
Outlook profile corruption prevents email access on corporate laptops.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Create a new Outlook profile, check Group Policy settings for roaming profiles if applicable, use the `cleanmgr /sagerun:6` command to clean up system files, and repair the user's roaming/mandatory profile if necessary.

title: M365 user unable to authenticate via Azure AD after organizational changes.
content:
Problem:
M365 user unable to authenticate via Azure AD after organizational changes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Recheck the user's assigned licenses and group memberships, validate the user's Azure AD account status (enabled, correct UPN), and reset the user's Azure AD password if authentication policies require it.

title: Teams audio consistently cuts out during enterprise meetings.
content:
Problem:
Teams audio consistently cuts out during enterprise meetings.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update Teams client to the latest version, disable third-party audio services (like WebEx or Cisco), check system volume levels and microphone permissions, and test audio output routing on the affected device.

title: VPN connection drops frequently on company network.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops frequently on company network.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check VPN client logs for specific error codes, verify firewall rules allow the VPN protocol (e.g., IPsec, OpenVPN), test connectivity from different network segments, and ensure the VPN server certificate is still valid and trusted.

title: Teams screen sharing fails to work on multiple corporate Macs.
content:
Problem:
Teams screen sharing fails to work on multiple corporate Macs.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update Teams for Mac, reset Teams preferences (`~/Library/Application Support/Microsoft/Teams/`) and ensure system QuickTime components are updated, check screen sharing permissions in System Preferences/Security & Privacy.

title: Dell laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects.
content:
Problem:
Dell laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update Dell wireless drivers, reset the Dell wireless module (typically via Fn + specific keys or command in Device Manager), check for firmware updates for the wireless card, and disable power-saving settings for the adapter.

title: Outlook search results exclude emails from specific Exchange mailboxes.
content:
Problem:
Outlook search results exclude emails from specific Exchange mailboxes.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check the mailbox's Outlook search properties, disable Outlook search indexing during a manual rebuild, verify the Autodiscover configuration (`autodiscover.xml`) and run `Set-MailboxSearchConfiguration` in Exchange PowerShell for relevant litigation holds or compliance searches.

title: Corporate users unable to access internal resources via M365 SharePoint Online.
content:
Problem:
Corporate users unable to access internal resources via M365 SharePoint Online.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify SharePoint site collection status and health in the Microsoft 365 admin center, check user permissions inheritance and effective permissions on the target sites, and ensure the users have the correct Microsoft 365 licenses that include SharePoint access.

title: Windows login fails with cached credentials error.
content:
Problem:
Windows login fails with cached credentials error.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Clear Windows credentials from Control Panel, disable autologon, reset network password manager, and restart with safe mode logon.

title: Windows update stuck at installing KB456789.
content:
Problem:
Windows update stuck at installing KB456789.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Force update uninstall via DISM, reset Windows update components, check for mixed precision dependencies, and re-run Windows Update troubleshooter.

title: Windows laptop runs slowly with high disk usage.
content:
Problem:
Windows laptop runs slowly with high disk usage.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run disk cleanup, defragment drive (if HDD), check for shadow copies, disable hibernation, and scan for corrupt file system errors.

title: M365 license shows as active but user cannot sign in.
content:
Problem:
M365 license shows as active but user cannot sign in.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Verify license assignment in Azure AD, check for user suspension, reset user activation status, and re-issue activation key if needed.

title: M365 activation error 0x8007251B on new device.
content:
Problem:
M365 activation error 0x8007251B on new device.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Ensure correct admin activation, disable device guard, remove conflicting licenses, and clear activation lock from previous owner.

title: Teams meeting invite accepted but unable to join.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting invite accepted but unable to join.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check meeting URL for typos, verify Teams client is up-to-date, test meeting URL in web browser, and clear Teams DNS cache.

title: Teams audio works in calls but not in meeting broadcast.
content:
Problem:
Teams audio works in calls but not in meeting broadcast.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update audio drivers, disable headset mic boost, reset Teams audio endpoints, and check firewall rules for UDP ports.

title: Outlook certificate error when sending email.
content:
Problem:
Outlook certificate error when sending email.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Remove invalid certificates from certificate store, repair Outlook profile, check SMTP server TLS settings, and re-import trusted root certs.

title: Outlook profile corrupt after domain migration.
content:
Problem:
Outlook profile corrupt after domain migration.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Repair corrupt profile store via Inplace or Standside move, rebuild Offline Address Book, re-add mailboxes via admin, and reset Outlook data file permissions.

title: Outlook fails to connect to Exchange with error 0x80004005.
content:
Problem:
Outlook fails to connect to Exchange with error 0x80004005.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Rebuild cached Exchange mode, repair Microsoft Office data source, check Autodiscover service URL, and reset Outlook NDR settings.

title: Windows Update fails to install critical updates.
content:
Problem:
Windows Update fails to install critical updates.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Run Windows Update for Microsoft Security, use DISM /Online /Restore健康检查 /CheckHealth and DISM /Online /Restore健康检查 /FixHealth, then execute sfc /scannow, and check Group Policy for conflicting settings.

title: M365 login redirects to Microsoft account instead of Azure AD.
content:
Problem:
M365 login redirects to Microsoft account instead of Azure AD.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Check browser compatibility mode, reset browser settings, clear tenant cookies, and verify the `login-rp-default` browser local state value.

title: Teams meeting audio drops frequently during calls.
content:
Problem:
Teams meeting audio drops frequently during calls.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Test local audio with other apps, check Teams audio device settings, disable noise suppression, and review firewall rules for UDP ports 3478-3480.

title: Outlook add-in causes constant popup errors and hangs.
content:
Problem:
Outlook add-in causes constant popup errors and hangs.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Disable all add-ins in Safe Mode, re-register Microsoft.Office.Tools.Outlook, and check the registry key `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Office\Outlook\Addins` for corruption.

title: Dell laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects after waking from sleep.
content:
Problem:
Dell laptop wireless adapter intermittently disconnects after waking from sleep.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Update Dell wireless driver, reset Windows Socket Catalog, and check power plan settings for wireless adapter power saving modes.

title: VPN connection drops after 30 minutes, showing 'Connection was lost'.
content:
Problem:
VPN connection drops after 30 minutes, showing 'Connection was lost'.

Troubleshooting Steps / Solution:
Adjust IKEv2 rekey timers, disable split tunneling, check firewall rules for UDP 500/4500, and verify DNS settings on the client.

title: HP printer displays 'Network connection lost' but is connected via Ethernet.
content:
Problem:
HP printer displays 'Network connection lost' but is connected via Ethernet.
